headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of June 18, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 15.69% compared to SPY's 10.02%. This results in an average alpha of 5.66%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 28.59%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 8.57%, which is still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly relevant during times of market stress, as it suggests resilience relative to broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
